script:
control-agent-server doctor
control-agent-server llm preset deepseek --no-validate
P=$(control-agent-server fixture project --name qa-f27-proj --print-path)
F="$AGENT_SERVER_VERIFY_RUN/fixtures/qa-f27"
H="$AGENT_SERVER_VERIFY_RUN/home"
mkdir -p "$F/snake/.openhands" "$F/empty/.openhands" "$F/badjson/.openhands" "$F/unknown/.openhands" \
  "$F/snakeunknown/.openhands" "$F/both/.openhands" "$F/nocmd/.openhands" "$F/agentsdir/.agents" "$F/nohooks" \
  "$F/badskill/.agents/agents" "$P/.openhands/agents" "$P/.agents/agents/qa-nested-dir" "$H/.agents/agents" "$H/.openhands/agents"
printf '%s
' '{"pre_tool_use": [{"matcher": "terminal|file_editor", "hooks": [{"command": "echo QA_SNAKE", "timeout": 7, "async": true}]}], "Stop": [{"hooks": [{"type": "prompt", "prompt": "QA done?"}]}]}' > "$F/snake/.openhands/hooks.json"
printf '%s
' '{}' > "$F/empty/.openhands/hooks.json"
printf '%s
' '{bad' > "$F/badjson/.openhands/hooks.json"
printf '%s
' '{"PreToolUsage": [{"hooks": [{"command": "true"}]}]}' > "$F/unknown/.openhands/hooks.json"
printf '%s
' '{"pre_tool_usage": [{"hooks": [{"command": "true"}]}]}' > "$F/snakeunknown/.openhands/hooks.json"
printf '%s
' '{"PreToolUse": [{"hooks": [{"command": "true"}]}], "pre_tool_use": []}' > "$F/both/.openhands/hooks.json"
printf '%s
' '{"pre_tool_use": [{"hooks": [{"type": "command"}]}]}' > "$F/nocmd/.openhands/hooks.json"
printf '%s
' '{"pre_tool_use": [{"hooks": [{"command": "true"}]}]}' > "$F/agentsdir/.agents/hooks.json"
printf -- '---
name: qa-reviewer
description: QA reviewer. <example>review the qa fixture</example>
color: purple
tools:
  - terminal
  - file_editor
skills: qa-f27-proj-skill
permission_mode: never_confirm
max_iteration_per_run: 5
qa_extra: QA_META
---
You are the QA reviewer. Say QA_REVIEWER_MARKER.
' > "$P/.agents/agents/qa-reviewer.md"
printf -- '---
name: general-purpose
description: QA override of a built-in
---
QA_OVERRIDE_BODY
' > "$P/.agents/agents/general-purpose.md"
printf -- '---
name: qa-bad-mode
permission_mode: sometimes
---
QA_BAD
' > "$P/.agents/agents/qa-bad-mode.md"
printf -- '---
name: qa-bad-iter
max_iteration_per_run: 0
---
QA_BAD
' > "$P/.agents/agents/qa-bad-iter.md"
printf -- '---
name: qa-readme
---
QA_README
' > "$P/.agents/agents/README.md"
printf -- '---
name: qa-nested
---
QA_NESTED
' > "$P/.agents/agents/qa-nested-dir/qa-nested.md"
printf 'name: qa-notes
' > "$P/.agents/agents/qa-notes.txt"
printf -- '---
description: QA legacy project agent
---
QA_LEGACY_AGENT
' > "$P/.openhands/agents/qa-legacy-agent.md"
printf -- '---
name: qa-reviewer
description: QA shadowed copy
---
QA_SHADOWED
' > "$P/.openhands/agents/qa-reviewer.md"
printf -- '---
name: qa-helper
description: QA user copy of qa-helper
---
QA_USER_COPY
' > "$H/.agents/agents/qa-helper.md"
printf -- '---
name: qa-user-agent
description: QA user agent
---
QA_USER_AGENT
' > "$H/.agents/agents/qa-user-agent.md"
printf -- '---
name: qa-persist-agent
description: QA persistence-dir agent
---
QA_PERSIST_AGENT
' > "$H/.openhands/agents/qa-persist-agent.md"
printf -- '---
name: qa-bad-skill
description: QA agent naming a missing skill
skills: qa-f27-missing-skill
---
QA_BAD_SKILL
' > "$F/badskill/.agents/agents/qa-bad-skill.md"
CHROME=$(control-agent-server capabilities | jq -r '.machine.chromium.detail')
PW="$F/playwright"
mkdir -p "$PW/chromium-qa/chrome-linux"
ln -sfn "$(readlink -f "$CHROME")" "$PW/chromium-qa/chrome-linux/chrome"
test -x "$PW/chromium-qa/chrome-linux/chrome"
mkdir -p "$F/pytools"
cat > "$F/pytools/qa_f27_tools.py" <<'EOF'
from pydantic import Field

from openhands.sdk import Action, Observation, ToolDefinition
from openhands.sdk.tool import ToolExecutor, register_tool


class QaF27EchoAction(Action):
    marker: str = Field(description="The marker text to echo back.")


class QaF27EchoObservation(Observation):
    pass


class QaF27EchoExecutor(ToolExecutor):
    def __call__(self, action, conversation=None):
        return QaF27EchoObservation.from_text(text=f"QA_F27_ECHO_RAN {action.marker}")


class QaF27EchoTool(ToolDefinition[QaF27EchoAction, QaF27EchoObservation]):
    @classmethod
    def create(cls, conv_state=None, **params):
        return [cls(description="QA echo tool: returns the marker it is given.", action_type=QaF27EchoAction,
                    observation_type=QaF27EchoObservation, executor=QaF27EchoExecutor())]


register_tool("qa_f27_echo", QaF27EchoTool)
EOF
.venv/bin/python -I -c 'import sys; sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1]); import qa_f27_tools' "$F/pytools"
